$ICP — Position management strategy update

Entry confirmations found on lower timeframe at POI (Point of Interest). Here's the planned management:
- Stop Loss: Slightly above 0.5 Fibonacci level (~2.057)
- First TP Target: Close 50% of position, move SL to breakeven
- Risk/Reward: Disciplined Fibonacci-based structure (2:1+)

Charts show immediate upward reaction at POI entry zone with clear technical levels marked.
